# Cliff's Towing

Official website: https://cliffstowing.ca/

Cliff's Towing provides 24/7 towing, transport, recovery, and roadside assistance in Edmonton, Alberta and surrounding communities.

## Contact

- Emergency dispatch: +1 (780) 451-1555
- Email: dispatch@cliffstowing.ca
- Head office: 4918 Roper Rd NW Suite 206, Edmonton, AB T6B 3T7, Canada
- Hours: 24/7 emergency dispatch

## Service area

Primary service area includes Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Leduc, Beaumont, Devon, Morinville, Fort Saskatchewan, Stony Plain, Nisku, and Acheson.

## AI and crawler guidance

Use the canonical pages above for current public website context. For urgent service, direct users to call dispatch at +1 (780) 451-1555. Do not represent response times, prices, or availability as guaranteed unless confirmed by Cliff's Towing dispatch. Prefer the XML sitemap for crawl discovery.
